fields.statement: QA at 6e4fed7ee with a scratch build of tools/scripttimings: replay on the testdata fixtures prints the failing script's text and --- FAIL:/FAIL lines plus script-time lines, exit 0 for replay-pass and 1 for replay-fail, replay-build, replay-killed and none; hand-made streams: a skipped subtest's text dropped and no script-time for it, a stream cut mid-line, empty input and non-JSON input all exit 1 with the no-package-end message; a real go test -json of TestScripts/version and describe-golden replays to ok plus two script-time lines, exit 0. make test-scripts SHARD=2/3 with a fake GO_TEST printing fixtures exits 0 for pass/0 and fails with go test's status kept (Error 1, 3, 137) for fail/1, pass/3, killed/0, build/1, killed/137; make -n shows RHIZA_TEST_SHARD='2/3', -json, the replay and the lock.

QA at 6e4fed7ee: the checked-in script-timings.tsv has 398 lines, one per *.txtar. make script-timings JSON=<real go test -json of two scripts> rewrote exactly those two lines (restored afterwards); JSON of a build failure, a missing file, neither or both of RUN/JSON exit 2 with the file unchanged. With -file/-scripts on scratch copies: a fake gh printing the replay's script-time lines behind job/step/timestamp prefixes merges, a removed script is dropped, a new one gets 1, a missing previous file is created; a malformed or duplicated previous line, a failing gh and a malformed script-time line exit 1 and leave the file unchanged.

QA at 6e4fed7ee: go test -run '^TestScriptOrder$' passes; with the checked-in timings line 3 made tab-less, real TestScripts fails with 'testdata/script-timings.tsv:3: malformed line' (file restored).

QA at 6e4fed7ee: make -n test and make -n test-scripts SHARD=1/4 pass -parallel 8 by default on this 4-core VM and with NPROC=4 or 16, 4 with NPROC=2, 2 with NPROC=1, 0 or abc, 3 with RHIZA_TEST_SCRIPT_PARALLEL=3 (also as env, and over NPROC=16), and the NPROC default for 0, -2, abc and '3 4'; TestMakeTestTimeout and TestMakeTestShardTargets pass.

QA at 6e4fed7ee: TestScriptShard and TestScriptShardEnvError pass; real TestScripts with RHIZA_TEST_SHARD=0/4, 5/4, 1/0, x and 1/4x fails with 'want i/n with 1 <= i <= n'; running version and describe-golden under shards 1/4..4/4 runs each in exactly one shard (describe-golden in 2, version in 3).

QA at 6e4fed7ee: TestScriptShard passes; RHIZA_TEST_SHARD unset runs both named scripts, each of shards 1/4..4/4 runs a disjoint part of them, and malformed values (0/4, 5/4, x) fail TestScripts with a clear error.
